reading_note: The teaching describes how the operative divine power, after establishing the spiritual worlds, arranged states of being in nested order — each lower state of self-love bound and contained within a higher state of divine good that receives and holds it. The arc moves from the act of construction, to the binding of the five modes of self-love within the five degrees of divine truth (the sons of the First Man), to the further nesting of degrees up to the firmament that bounds the whole cosmic order. The single arc: the divine ordering by which evils are not destroyed but fettered inside corresponding goods, so that every lower state is enclosed by a higher one, ascending to the boundary of heaven itself.
